item.bromaxpestilence.plague_mask.desc: Herbs in the beak keep the miasma out. Blocks coughs and miasma; halves infection by contact.
item.bromaxpestilence.four_thieves_vineg: Cures Pneumonic Plague, and wards off sickness for a while after.
item.bromaxpestilence.shrouded_corpse.de: Heavy, and still rotting. Take it to a lit pyre before it stirs.
message.bromaxpestilence.infected: You feel a chill. Something is wrong.
message.bromaxpestilence.stage2: The sickness is at its worst.
message.bromaxpestilence.recovered: The fever breaks. You have survived the sickness.
message.bromaxpestilence.doctor_near: Somewhere nearby, a cane taps against the ground...
message.bromaxpestilence.corpse_dropped: The corpse stirs! You let it fall.
command.bromaxpestilence.status: Pestilence phase %s (%s): %s Plague Points, next phase at %s
command.bromaxpestilence.capped: The Pestilence will not pass phase %s (%s). Preset: %s
message.bromaxpestilence.halt_hover: Stop it from ever climbing past this phase, for a lighter plague. /pestilence resume undoes it.
message.bromaxpestilence.halted: The Pestilence is stayed: it will climb no higher than phase %s (%s).
message.bromaxpestilence.resumed: The Pestilence is unchained once more.
message.bromaxpestilence.farm_rats: Rats have come for your harvest.
phase.bromaxpestilence.0.desc: The sickness sleeps. Only a few rats carry it.
phase.bromaxpestilence.1.desc: Rats multiply in the dark. Coughs are heard in the villages.
phase.bromaxpestilence.2.desc: The herds sicken and die. Burn the dead, or they will not stay dead.
phase.bromaxpestilence.3.desc: The Afflicted walk at night, even where nothing died.
phase.bromaxpestilence.5.desc: Something is spreading the plague on purpose.
message.bromaxpestilence.nest_formed.rat: You hear scratching beneath the earth nearby...
message.bromaxpestilence.nest_formed.pla: Somewhere nearby, the ground opens over the dead...
message.bromaxpestilence.nest_formed.mia: A foul green smell drifts in on the wind...
The warren collapses. The Pestilence weakens.
The pit is filled. The Pestilence weakens.
The well runs dry. The Pestilence weakens.
disease.bromaxpestilence.bubonic.treat: Treat with a Plague Poultice. A lancet can knock back the Buboes.
disease.bromaxpestilence.pneumonic.treat: Treat with Four Thieves Vinegar. Keep away from others: it spreads fast.
disease.bromaxpestilence.septicemic.trea: Treat with Wormwood Tincture. Leeches can draw it back a stage.
disease.bromaxpestilence.dysentery.treat: Treat with Herbal Broth. Mind what you eat and drink.
message.bromaxpestilence.diagnosis.immun: %s: healthy, and immune for about %s more minutes.
message.bromaxpestilence.wrong_remedy: It does nothing for this sickness.
message.bromaxpestilence.lancet.works: The buboes are lanced. The fever eases a little.
message.bromaxpestilence.lancet.useless: There is nothing here to lance.
message.bromaxpestilence.leeches.works: The leeches draw out the bad blood.
message.bromaxpestilence.leeches.useless: The leeches feed, to no purpose.
message.bromaxpestilence.censer_empty: The censer needs dried herbs to burn.
message.bromaxpestilence.apothecary.need: This preparation needs heat: a fire, campfire or lit brazier nearby.
item.bromaxpestilence.theriac.desc: The old cure-all. Cures any of the sicknesses.
item.bromaxpestilence.physicians_kit.des: Use on a patient (or in the air, on yourself) to name the sickness.
item.bromaxpestilence.lancet.desc: Lances buboes: knocks severe Bubonic Plague back a stage. It hurts.
item.bromaxpestilence.leech_jar.desc: Bloodletting: draws Septicemic Plague back a stage. It hurts.
item.bromaxpestilence.censer.desc: Burns dried herbs. Held and lit, its smoke keeps coughs and miasma from you and those near you.
item.bromaxpestilence.doctors_garb.desc: Waxed against contagion. With the mask, the full garb keeps bites and filth from infecting you.
message.bromaxpestilence.village_outbrea: The plague has come to the village. Coughing behind every door...
message.bromaxpestilence.village_survive: The village has weathered the plague.
message.bromaxpestilence.village_fallen: The village has fallen to the Pestilence.
message.bromaxpestilence.village_found_f: This village was lost to the plague. The doors are marked, and the dead lie unburied.
message.bromaxpestilence.village_thanks: The villagers will not forget your care (%s treated).
message.bromaxpestilence.too_sick_to_tra: This villager is too sick to trade.
disease.bromaxpestilence.rot.treat: Only Theriac cures the Rot. Beasts and villagers that reach its worst turn Afflicted.
item.bromaxpestilence.rat_crown.desc: Rats will not set upon whoever wears it.
message.bromaxpestilence.rat_king: Something huge and many-legged tears loose from the warren. The Rat King has come.
message.bromaxpestilence.seal_broken: The seal cracks. Below, something enormous gets to its feet.
message.bromaxpestilence.pale_rider: A pale horse, and he that sat on him... The Pale Rider has come.
item.bromaxpestilence.pyre_torch.desc: Sets whatever it strikes alight. Burns corpses and lights pyres.
item.bromaxpestilence.quicklime_bomb.des: Cleanses blight, dissolves corpses and kills vermin clouds where it bursts; burns the plague's creatures.
item.bromaxpestilence.fumigation_bomb.de: Leaves herb smoke for thirty seconds: no coughs or miasma within, and no fleas or flies.
item.bromaxpestilence.bone_saw.desc: Quick and light. Use on a corpse to saw it apart for bone and ichor (wear the garb).
item.bromaxpestilence.censer_flail.desc: Slow and heavy. Each blow clears miasma and vermin clouds; double harm to Miasma Wraiths.
item.bromaxpestilence.gravediggers_spade: Reaches further. Use on a corpse to bury it where it lies.
item.bromaxpestilence.consecrated_cleave: Grows with good deeds, not killing: curing, burning the dead, breaking nests, saving villages.
item.bromaxpestilence.pomander.desc: A ball of scented herbs. Halves the chance of catching anything from the air.
The Pestilence's own heart, bound in gold. No sickness can touch you, nor Dread, Delirium or Rotting.
item.bromaxpestilence.charm.plain: Works held in the offhand (the amulet: anywhere in your inventory).
disease.bromaxpestilence.sweating.treat: Sleep through the night and it breaks. Herbal Broth or Theriac cure it too.
